# Terraform AWS ECR Repositories Management Module

 [![Latest Release](https://img.shields.io/github/release/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-ecr-repositories.svg?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-ecr-repositories/releases/latest) [![Last Updated](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-ecr-repositories.svg?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-ecr-repositories/commits)


This module manages AWS ECR repositories, providing a streamlined approach to creating,
configuring, and maintaining container image repositories on AWS. It supports features such as
lifecycle policies, encryption, repository policies, image scanning, and registry-wide configurations.
Key features include:
- Multiple repository management
- Customizable lifecycle policies
- KMS encryption support
- Image scanning configuration
- Repository and registry IAM policies
- Tag immutability controls


---

## Introduction

The AWS ECR Repositories Management Module simplifies the process of creating and managing
Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR) repositories through Infrastructure as Code. It provides
a comprehensive solution for organizations needing to maintain multiple container image repositories
with standardized configurations and security policies.

## Usage


**IMPORTANT:** The `master` branch is used in `source` just as an example. In your code, do not pin to `master` because there may be breaking changes between releases.
Instead pin to the release tag (e.g. `?ref=vX.Y.Z`) of one of our [latest releases](https://github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-ecr-repositories/releases).


Bootstrap each deployment with Terragrunt scaffold from the target deployment directory. Scaffold copies
`.boilerplate/inputs.yaml`, `.boilerplate/terragrunt.hcl`, and `local-tags.json` into the current directory.

```sh
# 1. Create and enter the target deployment directory
mkdir -p dev/us-east-1/core/ecr-repositories
cd dev/us-east-1/core/ecr-repositories

# 2. Scaffold the module (do NOT use --working-dir)
terragrunt scaffold github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-ecr-repositories

# 3. Edit inputs.yaml with deployment-specific values
#    (all keys and comments are pre-populated from .boilerplate/inputs.yaml)
vi inputs.yaml

# 4. Apply
terragrunt apply
```

Generated `inputs.yaml`:

```yaml
# Module configuration

repositories: [] # (Optional) List of ECR repositories to create. Default: [].
# repositories:
#   - name: "app-repository" # (Required) ECR repository name.
#     force_delete: false # (Optional) Delete the repository even when it contains images. Default: false.
#     image_tag_mutability: "IMMUTABLE" # (Optional) Tag mutability. Valid values: MUTABLE, IMMUTABLE. Default: IMMUTABLE.
#     encryption_type: "AES256" # (Optional) Repository encryption type. Valid values: AES256, KMS. Default: AES256 unless default_kms_key is set.
#     kms_key: "" # (Optional) KMS key ARN used when encryption_type is KMS. Default: default_kms_key.
#     scan_on_push: false # (Optional) Enable repository scan-on-push. Default: false.
#     lifecycle_policy_rules: [] # (Optional) Repository-specific lifecycle policy rules. Default: [].
#     # lifecycle_policy_rules:
#     #   - rule_priority: 1 # (Required) Unique rule priority; lower numbers are evaluated first.
#     #     description: "Keep last 30 untagged images" # (Optional) Human-readable rule description. Default: null.
#     #     selection:
#     #       tag_status: "untagged" # (Required) Image tag status. Valid values: tagged, untagged, any.
#     #       tag_prefix_list: [] # (Optional) Tag prefixes for tagged images. Default: null.
#     #       tag_pattern_list: [] # (Optional) Tag patterns for tagged images. Default: null.
#     #       count_type: "sinceImagePushed" # (Required) Count type. Valid values: imageCountMoreThan, sinceImagePushed.
#     #       count_unit: "days" # (Optional) Count unit for sinceImagePushed. Valid values: days. Default: COUNT_NONE.
#     #       count_number: 30 # (Required) Number of images or days, depending on count_type.
#     #     action:
#     #       type: "expire" # (Required) Lifecycle action type. Valid value: expire.
#     policy: # (Optional) Repository IAM policy document inputs. Default: no repository policy.
#       statements: [] # (Optional) IAM policy statements for this repository. Default: [].
#       # statements:
#       #   - sid: "AllowPull" # (Optional) Statement identifier. Default: null.
#       #     effect: "Allow" # (Required) Statement effect. Valid values: Allow, Deny.
#       #     actions: ["ecr:BatchGetImage", "ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer"] # (Required) IAM actions granted or denied.
#       #     resources: ["*"] # (Required) IAM resources for the statement.
#       #     conditions: [] # (Optional) IAM condition blocks. Default: [].
#       #     # conditions:
#       #     #   - test: "StringEquals" # (Required) IAM condition operator.
#       #     #     variable: "aws:PrincipalOrgID" # (Required) IAM condition context key.
#       #     #     values: ["o-example"] # (Required) IAM condition values.

default_kms_key: "" # (Optional) Default KMS key ARN for repository encryption. Default: "" uses AES256 unless a repository overrides encryption_type/kms_key.

registry_policy: [] # (Optional) Registry-wide IAM policy document inputs. Default: [] disables registry policy creation.
# registry_policy:
#   statements:
#     - sid: "AllowRegistryRead" # (Optional) Statement identifier. Default: null.
#       effect: "Allow" # (Required) Statement effect. Valid values: Allow, Deny.
#       actions: ["ecr:DescribeRepositories"] # (Required) IAM actions granted or denied.
#       resources: ["*"] # (Required) IAM resources for the statement.
#       conditions: [] # (Optional) IAM condition blocks. Default: [].
#       # conditions:
#       #   - test: "StringEquals" # (Required) IAM condition operator.
#       #     variable: "aws:PrincipalOrgID" # (Required) IAM condition context key.
#       #     values: ["o-example"] # (Required) IAM condition values.

scanning: # (Optional) Registry scanning configuration. Default: BASIC with no rules.
  scan_type: "BASIC" # (Optional) Registry scan type. Valid values: BASIC, ENHANCED. Default: BASIC.
  rules: [] # (Optional) Registry scanning rules. Default: [].
  # rules:
  #   - scan_frequency: "SCAN_ON_PUSH" # (Optional) Scan frequency. Valid values: SCAN_ON_PUSH, CONTINUOUS_SCAN. Default: SCAN_ON_PUSH.
  #     filter: "*" # (Optional) Repository filter pattern. Default: *.
  #     filter_type: "WILDCARD" # (Optional) Repository filter type. Valid value: WILDCARD. Default: WILDCARD.

default_lifecycle_policy: [] # (Optional) Default lifecycle policy applied to repositories without lifecycle_policy_rules. Default: [] disables default lifecycle policies.
# default_lifecycle_policy:
#   rules:
#     - rule_priority: 1 # (Required) Unique rule priority; lower numbers are evaluated first.
#       description: "Keep last 30 untagged images" # (Optional) Human-readable rule description. Default: null.
#       selection:
#         tag_status: "untagged" # (Required) Image tag status. Valid values: tagged, untagged, any.
#         tag_prefix_list: [] # (Optional) Tag prefixes for tagged images. Default: null.
#         tag_pattern_list: [] # (Optional) Tag patterns for tagged images. Default: null.
#         count_type: "sinceImagePushed" # (Required) Count type. Valid values: imageCountMoreThan, sinceImagePushed.
#         count_unit: "days" # (Optional) Count unit for sinceImagePushed. Valid values: days. Default: COUNT_NONE.
#         count_number: 30 # (Required) Number of images or days, depending on count_type.
#       action:
#         type: "expire" # (Required) Lifecycle action type. Valid value: expire.
```

Generated `terragrunt.hcl` (without optional EKS dependency wiring):

```hcl
locals {
  local_vars  = yamldecode(file("./inputs.yaml"))
  spoke_vars  = yamldecode(file(find_in_parent_folders("spoke-inputs.yaml")))
  region_vars = yamldecode(file(find_in_parent_folders("region-inputs.yaml")))
  env_vars    = yamldecode(file(find_in_parent_folders("env-inputs.yaml")))
  global_vars = yamldecode(file(find_in_parent_folders("global-inputs.yaml")))

  local_tags  = jsondecode(file("./local-tags.json"))
  spoke_tags  = jsondecode(file(find_in_parent_folders("spoke-tags.json")))
  region_tags = jsondecode(file(find_in_parent_folders("region-tags.json")))
  env_tags    = jsondecode(file(find_in_parent_folders("env-tags.json")))
  global_tags = jsondecode(file(find_in_parent_folders("global-tags.json")))

  tags = merge(
    local.global_tags,
    local.env_tags,
    local.region_tags,
    local.spoke_tags,
    local.local_tags
  )
}

include "root" {
  path = find_in_parent_folders("root.hcl")
}

terraform {
  source = "github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-ecr-repositories"
}

inputs = {
  is_hub                   = false
  org                      = local.env_vars.org
  spoke_def                = local.spoke_vars.spoke
  repositories             = try(local.local_vars.repositories, [])
  default_kms_key          = try(local.local_vars.default_kms_key, "")
  registry_policy          = try(local.local_vars.registry_policy, [])
  scanning                 = try(local.local_vars.scanning, {})
  default_lifecycle_policy = try(local.local_vars.default_lifecycle_policy, [])
  extra_tags               = local.tags
}
```

## Quick Start

1. Create and enter the target Terragrunt deployment directory.
2. Run `terragrunt scaffold github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-ecr-repositories`.
3. Edit `inputs.yaml` and define the ECR repositories, lifecycle rules, scanning settings, and optional policies.
4. Run `terragrunt plan`, review the changes, then run `terragrunt apply`.


## Examples

Example `inputs.yaml` for an immutable application repository with scan-on-push and a retention policy:

```yaml
repositories:
  - name: "app-repository"
    force_delete: false
    image_tag_mutability: "IMMUTABLE"
    encryption_type: "AES256"
    scan_on_push: true
    lifecycle_policy_rules:
      - rule_priority: 1
        description: "Expire untagged images older than 30 days"
        selection:
          tag_status: "untagged"
          count_type: "sinceImagePushed"
          count_unit: "days"
          count_number: 30
        action:
          type: "expire"
    policy:
      statements: []

default_kms_key: ""
registry_policy: []
scanning:
  scan_type: "BASIC"
  rules: []
default_lifecycle_policy: []
```
